details.description: StartTranscriptionJob is the Amazon Transcribe API operation that runs an asynchronous (batch) speech-to-text job: given a media file already uploaded to Amazon S3, it returns a text transcript, optionally with speaker diarization, custom-vocabulary support, PII redaction, toxic-speech detection, and subtitle output. Amazon Transcribe is AWS's fully managed automatic speech recognition service, which AWS describes as powered by a next-generation, multi-billion-parameter speech foundation model trained on millions of hours of audio. This operation covers Transcribe's batch mode only; real-time audio uses a separate streaming API.
advantages: AWS states Amazon Transcribe is powered by a next-generation, multi-billion-parameter speech foundation model trained on millions of hours of audio data.
Supports automatic single- or multi-language identification, so the spoken language does not need to be known in advance.
Can apply custom vocabularies and custom language models to improve recognition of domain-specific terms, and vocabulary filters to mask, remove, or tag specific words such as profanity.
Offers built-in personally identifiable information (PII) redaction and toxic-speech detection on the resulting transcript.
Can generate WebVTT and SubRip subtitle files directly from a transcription job.
Supports speaker diarization (configurable speaker-label count) and channel identification for multi-channel audio.
disadvantages: StartTranscriptionJob only transcribes media already uploaded to Amazon S3; real-time audio requires Amazon Transcribe's separate streaming API.
AWS's API reference and documentation for this operation publish no accuracy (word error rate) figures.
use_cases: Transcribing pre-recorded audio or video files stored in Amazon S3, such as call recordings or meeting recordings.
Generating WebVTT or SubRip subtitle files for recorded media.
Producing redacted transcripts that mask personally identifiable information for compliance workflows.
Batch transcription with custom vocabulary or a custom language model for domain-specific audio.

notes: StartTranscriptionJob is an API operation of Amazon Transcribe (batch/asynchronous mode), not a distinctly named model; this write-up describes that batch transcription capability. Languages are deduped from AWS's 'Supported languages and language-specific features' table, which lists some regional dialects (e.g. several English and Spanish variants, five Swahili country variants) separately; all listed languages support at least batch mode. AWS's API reference for this operation lists a slightly different but overlapping language-code set (includes Scottish Gaelic and Maori codes not present in the supported-languages table); only languages confirmed on the supported-languages page are listed here. No maker-published accuracy/WER percentage for this operation was found, so evaluations is empty.
